cost_meanings.arguments: first-use argument lengths and bytes, deterministic repeat events
cost_meanings.content: executed content references and raw-baseline byte events
cost_meanings.definitions: literal spelling bytes and lengths, including first-use dictionary entries
cost_meanings.framing: archive/frame headers and deferred arithmetic termination/checksum bytes
cost_meanings.program: grammar definitions, root instructions, calls, node tags and references

synchronization.attribution: category at byte emission; delayed and terminal bytes in framing

model_spec.checksum: SHA256 symmetric complete state digest appended after canonical arithmetic body
model_spec.common_trace: event schedule, contexts and categories, every count replacement/update, probabilities, decoded bits, common arithmetic state and emitted output
model_spec.cost_attribution: whole arithmetic bytes charged to event category when emitted; final partial byte, four zero lookahead bytes and32-byte state digest charged to framing
model_spec.decoder_lookahead: decoder-only code register excluded from symmetric digest; common interval checked against encoder shadow after every bit
model_spec.hash: BLAKE2b64, little-endian words, explicit domains; zero tag maps to1
model_spec.replacement: direct mapped; new64-bit tag resets counts to the table's initial counts
model_spec.tree: balanced halves of [0,alphabet); floor midpoint; zero chooses lower half
model_spec.update: after each decoded bit, increment both matching counts; at total>=32768 ceil-half each count
